items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I saw, talking about Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Keller, Kid René, and Jack Keller. I just wanted to see them fellas, them time with big shots.

ctx.x: I guess you were always on the other side of the stage.
Yeah. And I saw, talking about Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Keller, Kid René, and Jack Keller. I just wanted to see them fellas, them time with big shots.
Well, a little bit. And you were with them?
